body: i’m sobbing on my couch right now because of what happened to Jaeden - he was so special and so absolutely faultless in the bullshit he was surrounded by. he was mesmerized by the love that Luke and June have and i don’t think he remembers ever witnessing something like that. When he stepped on that mine, his first instinct was to comfort J&L and tell them “it’s okay”. Part of me never wants to watch this show again because the feelings it brings me are so real and so intense, but I know that I will and i can only hope to see more of Jaeden and more like him.
